subject.title: feat: carry Featured state into Control

question: Should schema-v1 hosted entries that omit `featured` preserve bundled curation, or should successful hosted feeds treat omission as authoritative false?
rationale: The field is optional and the current production producer omits it, so the answer determines whether existing Control users temporarily lose all published Featured entries and whether a producer capability/version marker is required.

options.title: Preserve legacy omission
options.body: Treat `undefined` as unknown, override only on explicit booleans, and add a capability or equivalent rule for authoritative feed omission.

options.title: Require producer-first rollout
options.body: Keep omission authoritative false, but merge only after the production producer emits explicit booleans for all official entries and supply rollback and live proof.

options.title: Pause for versioned contract
options.body: Hold the consumer change until the producer exposes a versioned or capability-marked curation contract that removes the ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy omission
recommendation.body: Treat `undefined` as unknown, override only on explicit booleans, and add a capability or equivalent rule for authoritative feed omission.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns this consumer branch and has prior merged ClawHub integration history relevant to coordinating the producer contract.
